snippet.title: To the Moon - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re bringing the deeply influential first installment of To the Moon to PS5 & Xbox Series X|S! 💚

Wishlist the game on your platform of choice today: 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012096
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n18q862hs1c 
Game Page: https://serenityforge.com/game/to-the-moon

We’re so excited to bring this classic indie adventure to modern consoles with a variety of new features and quality-of-life improvements:

🖼️  True 16:9 presentation
🎥 4k resolutions & up to 120hz framerates
🎮 PS5 DualSense haptics support
🔎 New achievements
